title: Ex-Seahawks player, Huskies alum to oversee USA flag football for 2028 Olympics

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ex-Seahawks player, Huskies alum to oversee USA flag football for 2028 Olympics
sources.description: The multi-time Pro Bowl fullback who holds a piece of Huskies history will have a major role in the 2028 Summer Olympics.
